summary: Readvantage Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 on September 3, 2026, announcing that its board unanimously approved the cancellation and retirement of 1.5 million restricted common shares voluntarily surrendered for no consideration by officer and 5%+ shareholder Ilona Andzejevska. The cancellation was effected under Nevada law, involved no payment or issuance, and did not change control. Post-cancellation shares outstanding were 5,447,400, confirmed by the transfer agent. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping event, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or strategic implications are present.
